models: Audi A3 / VW Golf / Seat Leon
commonCauses: Engine Control Module (ECM) replaced but Immobilizer not adapted
stepByStepSolution: Adapt Engine Control Module (ECM) to Immobilizer
Kontrol edin: /Update Engine Control Module (ECM) Software Version
technicalNotes:
When found in VW Golf (1K) or VW Touran (1T) 2.0l PD-TDI (AZV/BKD) Immobilizer Control Module:
Kontrol edin:  TPI 2007201 (RoW) for a possible Engine Control Module (ECM) Software Update.
